sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – 1.4404 bar: conditional packages for authorized pricing review
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation for the 1.4404 round bar (part:370010). We recognise that alloy prices have been volatile, and we are prepared to share part of that risk through a defined AS-14404 clause, as your letter proposes.

In our annual review, your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). We therefore ask you to put the complete packages below to the pricing committee or the authorized decision-maker now. Your sales director has also said that Werdenfels will focus on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). Each package commits our full 23,700 kg per year over a 24-month term. Lead time (14 days), DAP, the 2027-01-01 start and zero tooling stay as in our enquiry.

Package A: EUR 5.18/kg, payment 90 days net, 24 months, fixed price with no index clause.
Package B: EUR 5.13/kg, payment 90 days net, 24 months, AS-14404 index clause on a 45 % material share, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08.
Package C: EUR 4.94/kg, payment 14 days net, 24 months, AS-14404 index clause on a 45 % material share, 0 % deadband, base month 2026-08.

The three packages are approximately equivalent for us after rounding. You may choose the one that best fits your cost and cash position. Each price, payment term and clause is one indivisible conditional package. Faster payment or a narrower deadband applies only with that package price.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your proposal to implement the AS-14404 index clause and extend the contract to 24 months. 

Based on your third package featuring 14-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.60 per kg. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Please provide the detailed release schedule for the stated 23,700 kg annual volume to substantiate this calculation. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – complete 36-month packages for pricing committee approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving to a 24-month term with the AS-14404 clause.

On your volume question: the volume is the 23,700 kg per year stated in our enquiry. It will be fixed in the contract for the full term. We cannot increase that volume, but we can lengthen the commitment. Your sales director has said that Werdenfels will focus on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). We are therefore prepared to commit this volume for 36 months instead of 24, but only within one of the complete packages below.

Your offer combines 14-day payment and a 0 % deadband with EUR 5.60/kg. We offered those terms only as part of package C at that package's price. At EUR 5.60 they are not agreed, so we withdraw the 14-day / 0 % deadband structure. We propose instead:

Package A: EUR 5.25/kg, payment 90 days net, 36 months, AS-14404 index clause on a 45 % material share, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08.
Package B: EUR 5.18/kg, payment 30 days net, 36 months, AS-14404 index clause on a 45 % material share, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08.

The two packages are approximately equivalent for us after rounding. Lead time (14 days), DAP, the 2027-01-01 start and zero tooling stay as in our enquiry. Each price, payment term, clause and contract term is one indivisible conditional package. The 36-month commitment and faster payment apply only with that package price.

Your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please put these complete packages to the pricing committee or the authorized decision-maker now and return an authorized improved offer.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Part 370010 – 36-month commitment only within the complete package
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your reply and for confirming that your pricing committee has looked at our proposal.

Your offer takes the 36-month commitment and the 30-day payment from our second package, but keeps the price at EUR 5.60/kg, the same price you quoted before. We offered those terms only together with that package's price. At EUR 5.60 they are not agreed, and we withdraw the 30-day structure. A longer commitment from us needs a better price from you. Taking our terms without the price leaves the package unbalanced.

We confirm the AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband and our full 23,700 kg per year. Your sales director said that Werdenfels will focus on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). We remain prepared to commit that volume for 36 months, but only within this complete package:

Package A: EUR 5.25/kg, payment 90 days net, 36 months, AS-14404 index clause on a 45 % material share, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08.

Lead time (14 days), DAP, the 2027-01-01 start and zero tooling stay as in our enquiry. Price, payment term, clause and contract term form one indivisible conditional package. The 36-month commitment applies only with this package price.

Your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please obtain authorized approval for this complete package, or return an authorized improved price for it.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
